semiconductor_relevance: High — Wuxi Songyu Technology specializes in manufacturing semiconductor equipment, particularly in deposition technologies.
summary: Wuxi Songyu Technology Co., Ltd. is an equipment manufacturer focused on the research, development, and production of semiconductor and photovoltaic equipment. Established in 2017, the company offers a range of deposition equipment including ALD, PECVD, and LPCVD systems, catering to the needs of the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Wuxi, China, and has a team of over 100 technicians specializing in semiconductor equipment.
